Restart VMs.

```text
pomme restart [NAMES ...] [--mode MODE] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAMES` | VM names. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--mode MODE` | Override the preserved boot mode. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Agent readiness timeout in seconds for normal and Recovery boots. Default: `300.0`. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
